reading: The sketch shows a search-results style page: a wavy heading line and a shorter wavy subheading below it, a row of five equal rounded filter buttons (Price selected, plus Type of place, Rooms, Instant book, More filters), a large left box holding a list of listing cards (Guest favourite, Chiado studio 4.81, New, Graça terrace 4.77), and a large right panel meant to be a pale blue-grey map with small + / − zoom controls in its top-right corner.
